verdict.rationale: Carta is a SaaS platform with a developer API, so an official CLI is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a Carta CLI. The pack covers the REST API, OAuth, Postman access, MCP/Claude plugins and a data warehouse, but these are adjacent features and do not count as a command-line tool.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
